notes.title: 1.4 Update/Patch Notes
notes.content:
We just released the new update for the game that includes a new Robot Costume + Other fixes and optimizations!


[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Robo Bebe Costume Added To The Game
[*] Added Floating Origin Point to prevent Physics Breaking
[*] Fixed Language Options UI having No SFX
[*] Fixed Graphics Settings page for Brazilian Portuguese Localization
[*] Added French & Brazilian Portuguese Localization for the Tutorial 
[*] Added Interactable Snow in Snowy 'Splosion
[/list]


Thanks for your support! We hope you enjoy the game and the latest update.

notes.title: 1.3 Update / Patch Notes
notes.content:
With this update we have made a few changes, fixes and added a new feature!


Patch Notes Below
[list]
[*] Added Leaderboards in game
[*] Raised the invisible Ceiling to 200 instead of 125
[*] Fixed a major bug where you can go super far and break the game by using beans and pausing then unpausing
[*] Fixed the Royal Cannon's Accuracy
[*] Changed the cannons list in the shop to be sorted by price (Lowest To Highest). These cannons do get better and better the more expensive they are (Note: They do handle slightly differently too and may be more or less difficult to get max launch power)
[*] Fixed the Boulder's collider in Beach Blast
[/list]


Thanks for your continued support!

notes.title: 1.2 Update/Patch Notes
notes.content:
We have updated Launch The Baby! Here's a little list of changes.

[olist]
[*] General Optimization
[*] Game now detects your Refresh Rate and runs at it.
[*] Made "Snowy 'Splosion" load faster
[*] Tweaked the second portion of "Volcanic Velocity"
[*] Fixed being able to see the baby's eyes
[*] Added flying background babies in the Shop
[*] Adjusted Cannon prices
[*] Added a "+10" graphic to Coin FX to show you how many points they give
[*] Lifted the Game Ceiling higher.
[/olist]

Stay tuned for future updates and additional content! (More Levels, Quality of life features etc)
